quotes.author: Moats Nate
quotes.text: Captain Bill was awesome! We arrived a little early and left as soon as we were ready to do. We got lucky with an absolutely beautiful morning. We were able to see multiple different gators, birds and the everglades which to me are amazing. The airboat ride was awesome and Captain Bill is a very knowledgeable pilot of the boat, the wildlife, and the area. I highly recommend this adventure, it was outstanding! Thank you Captain Bill.

quotes.author: Joe Brocato
quotes.text: I have been on 4 airboat tours in the last 6 years and as good as they were none compare to Captain Bill, and his Cypress Outdoor adventures tour. He is the most knowledgeable, and funniest captain we have ever been around. His love of the Everglades, and love for people is very evident. I would recommend him to anyone who is looking for a great time, education, and entertainment.

quotes.author: Jedidiah Burt
quotes.text: The sunset airboat ride is so worth your time! Captain Bill and his better half were great hosts, very down to earth, knowledgeable about the area, and friendly. We appreciate your time, very memorable for us!!

quotes.author: Jayme Shaffer
quotes.text: Great tour; saw many birds and alligators. Captain Bill is a great, knowledgeable guide. Awesome airboat experience, can’t imagine anything better. I highly recommend the 2 hr private tour; worth ever penny!

quotes.author: Joel Vossmeyer
quotes.text: We had an amazing time! Easily the best thing we did our whole vacation. I would advise to take the 2 hour tour, it's so nice being out on the airboat. I will definitely be back.

quotes.author: Ken P
quotes.text: Great tour guides!! Thanks Captain Bill for the awesome ride through the everglades and finding a wild gator. I highly recommend this airboat tour.

quotes.author: Alicia Dolce
quotes.text: Six of us went out with Captain Bill last weekend and he was a fantastic guide! The boat was very comfortable and conditions this time of year were perfect but what made the trip extra enjoyable was Captain Bill’s knowledge of the Everglades, especially the gators. He spotted three of them and each time we stopped, he shared lots of interesting facts. Who knew alligators were such cool creatures? Book an airboat tour with Captain Bill. He’s the best!
